contract: Admission bounds unnormalized filter accumulation and absolute matrix row sums with +10-stop exposure, gamut and quadratic ACES headroom.
Finite float16 scene output saturates to signed +/-65504; float32 retains representable larger results.
limits: Conservative admission may refuse extreme finite profiles; not an exhaustive formal proof of every shader path or arbitrary nonfinite view parameters.
Physical HDR and independent camera appearance remain unverified.
